title: Hook
text: Ever booked a badminton court, and ended up one player short? Or posted in three group chats, and got two maybes and a thumbs up?

title: Meet Let's Sport
text: Meet Let's Sport! It brings your neighbours together for badminton and basketball. Signing up takes ten seconds… and yes, there's confetti.

title: Find a game
text: Here's what's happening near you. Every card shows the date, the venue, the skill level, and how many spots are left. Only into basketball? One tap.

title: Host a game
text: Want to start your own game? Pick a sport, give it a name, set the time, and drop a Google Maps pin, so nobody ends up at the wrong court.

title: It's live
text: Hit post, and your game is live for the whole neighbourhood.

title: Join in
text: Spotted a game you like? Tap "I'm in", and you're on the team. Plans change? One tap frees your spot for someone else.

title: Get there
text: On game day, open the map, and get directions right to the court.

title: Call to action
text: Badminton, basketball, and good company, all in one place. Sign up today, host your first game this week… and let's sport!
